purpose: What a working gold-plating bench reasons about and decides across the whole life of its solutions: which routes let contamination into each tank and gold out of it, how metallic, organic and carbonate signatures are read from the deposit and verified before anything is treated, which treatment method class answers which contamination class, when an aged or poisoned bath is regenerated versus replaced on evidence and economics, and how gold is recovered from spent solutions and rinses inside the segregation and regulated-waste obligations that govern every end-of-life act.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors

the shop runs purchased commercial plating chemistry with the technical data sheet of each product on file; the sibling selection KB has already chosen the bath families and the sibling analysis KB keeps each bath inside its TDS window day to day
grounding follows the in-repo process corpus (alkaline cyanide gold process file and the testing/QC acceptance file); anything that corpus marks unknown or jurisdiction-specific stays unknown here

published handbook-class ranges (carbonate service bands, tens-of-ppm metallic sensitivity) are cited only as handbook classes, never converted into the shop's own asserted limits; the specific product's TDS and its supplier's service guidance govern

cyanide-capable content assumes a lawfully licensed and trained line; where the shop lacks cyanide clearance the cyanide-specific branches are study-only and the non-cyanide branches carry the same lifecycle logic
exclusions: choosing gold systems, strike-build-color roles, support baths and substrate matching is the sibling bath-families-and-selection KB's territory; this KB receives a chosen, running line and manages its mortality

keeping a bath inside its window - what gold concentration, pH, temperature, agitation and additive balance each do, drift signatures, titration and analysis mechanics, replenishment discipline and the routine bath log - is the sibling analysis-and-replenishment KB's territory; this KB consumes its in-window verdict as the first gate of the contamination differential

the chemical prep line, rinse cascade design and water-break discipline as preparation procedure belong to the surface-preparation specialist; this KB governs only what carryover from that line does to bath life and what controls it imposes upstream

run-level execution - racking, transfer sequences, current and time arithmetic, rectifier work - belongs to the process-execution specialist; drag-in and drag-out appear here as bath-mortality and gold-economics mechanisms, not as run handling instructions
defect disposition of customer pieces, release decisions and strip-and-replate approvals belong to the quality specialist; deposit symptoms appear here only as bath-health evidence

full chemical-safety operations, waste characterization paperwork, manifest execution and destruction procedure belong to the safety-and-compliance specialist and to formal training; this KB names the obligation classes, holds the cyanide-acid segregation line and hands off

no numeric contamination limit, treatment dose or setpoint is stated as universal fact: published values appear only as labeled handbook classes and the technical data sheet of the specific commercial product governs every real number
no DIY bath formulation from raw chemicals and no improvised cyanide or waste procedure; commercial products per their TDS, formal-training pointers and verify-your-jurisdiction classes only

regulated marking terms, nickel-release limits and discharge rules are obligation classes with jurisdiction verification, never asserted thresholds, and nothing here is personalized legal, medical or financial advice

competency_questions.question: What actually kills the gold baths in this shop, and through which routes does each killer arrive, form or leave?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer maps, per tank, the drag-in routes, the in-situ aging products and the egress streams, and frames bath death as accumulation rather than a single event

competency_questions.question: Where do contamination tolerances and treatment procedures come from, and what may the bench never invent on its own?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer names the specific product's TDS and supplier service guidance as the governing sources, allows handbook-class ranges only as labeled classes, and routes anything the TDS is silent on to the supplier rather than to an invented number

competency_questions.question: How does the cyanide-acid segregation line shape every lifecycle action, from rinse routing to spent-solution storage and disposal staging?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer states the never-mix, never-store-together, never-share-a-drain rule, keeps every cyanide stream alkaline and labeled, and points to formal training and jurisdiction rules instead of improvised procedure

competency_questions.question: How is drag-out turned from the shop's largest gold loss into a controlled recovery stream?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer covers withdrawal and drain-dwell mechanics, the static drag-out rinse and its health-conditional return to the bath, and the recovery method classes for flowing rinses

competency_questions.question: Which in-tank components and quiet ingress routes can poison a bath from the inside, and how are they audited?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer names anodes, rack coatings, contacts, heaters and lost parts plus make-up water and airborne dust as sources, each with an inspection or control practice

competency_questions.question: How does the bench tell a metallic signature from an organic one from plain carbonate aging before treating anything?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer runs the analysis-first gate, then reads symptom character against the three class signatures, and requires verification by coupon, Hull cell panel or supplier lab before any treatment

competency_questions.question: What happens the moment a bath becomes credibly suspect - what stops, what gets tested, and what earns release?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer halts customer work into the tank, stops drag-out returns, runs coupons only, and releases on a passing verification coupon rather than on schedule pressure

competency_questions.question: Which treatment method class answers which contamination class, and how is success proven rather than assumed?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer maps filtration to particulate, carbon to organics with mandatory re-additive per TDS, dummying to metallics, and closes every treatment with a verification coupon before customer work resumes

competency_questions.question: Why is the gold strike run as a sacrificial fuse, and when is it dumped rather than saved?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer explains the strike's contamination-absorbing role in front of the build bath, the dump-and-remake doctrine with gold recovery from the spent strike, and why dosing a contaminated strike defeats its purpose

competency_questions.question: How does the shop decide between regenerating a sick or aged bath and replacing it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer weighs treatment cost, downtime and recurrence risk against remake cost net of recovered gold, uses the age ledger as its evidence base, and names the structural tipping facts such as small strike volumes and repeated signature returns

competency_questions.question: How is gold recovered from spent solutions and rinses without breaking waste rules, and where does the remainder legally go?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer sequences recovery before destruction or disposal, keeps cyanide streams alkaline and segregated throughout, names electrowinning, dummy cathodes, ion-exchange media and the refiner-credit route as classes, and hands final destruction and manifest work to trained, authorized channels with jurisdiction verification

competency_questions.question: How does each bath death or near-miss feed back into prevention so the successor bath lives longer?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the answer runs a short post-mortem per event and folds its findings into the mortality map, signature references, inspection cadences and prevention checklists

glossary.definition: The film of solution a part, rack or tool carries into a tank from the station before it; the dominant route by which foreign metals and organics enter a gold bath.
The film of bath solution that leaves the tank on the work and its rack; at small scale the shop's largest single gold-loss route, and a cyanide-bearing stream until treated.

A first, unplumbed rinse tank placed right after a gold bath to capture drag-out; while the bath is healthy its gold-bearing content can return to the bath as evaporation make-up, and otherwise it joins the recovery stream.

The in-service aging product of alkaline cyanide baths, formed by cyanide oxidation and absorbed carbon dioxide; published practice associates handbook-class service bands with dulling deposits and sagging efficiency.
A carbonate-removal remedy class in which the bath is chilled so carbonate crystallizes and is removed; executed per the product supplier's guidance.

Adsorption of dissolved organic contamination onto activated carbon, normally run in the filtration loop rather than as loose powder; it also strips the additive package, which must be re-dosed per the TDS afterwards.

A scavenging run at deliberately low current density onto a corrugated or scrap cathode so contaminant metals plate out preferentially, used as the metallic-class remedy and verified by before-and-after coupons.

A bench test cell that plates a single panel across a current-density gradient; the panel's pattern is read as a diagnosis method class for contamination and additive condition, checked against a known-good reference.
The number of times a bath's original metal content has been consumed and replenished in service; together with ampere-hours it is the age measure the lifecycle ledger tracks.
Electrolytic recovery of dissolved gold from spent solutions or loaded rinses onto a recoverable cathode, performed before any destruction or disposal step on a lawfully equipped line.

source_registry.description: heuristic prior estimates for gold_plating_bath_lifecycle work units in absence of supplied datasets
source_registry.citation_or_locator: heuristic prior; no external dataset supplied

nodes.definition: Frame every tank on the line as a mortal asset with a mass balance: what rides in on parts, racks and tools (drag-in), what forms in the solution as it works (carbonate from cyanide oxidation and absorbed air, spent additive fragments, metal dissolved from whatever the bath attacks), and what leaves on the work (drag-out, and the gold that goes with it). A gold bath almost never dies of one dramatic event; it dies of accumulation, so the bench's first expert act is to write, per tank, the ingress routes, the in-situ aging products and the egress streams, and then to treat every later contamination story as the question of which line item moved. This ledger is what turns 'the gold went dull' from a mystery into a short suspect list.

included: per-tank mapping of drag-in sources, in-situ aging products and drag-out destinations
accumulation as the working model of bath death
the shared vocabulary the rest of the lifecycle KB builds on
excluded: parameter drift inside the TDS window (sibling analysis KB)
which baths exist on the line at all (sibling selection KB)
run-level transfer handling (process-execution specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a supplier service bulletin or a shop post-mortem that names an ingress, in-situ or egress route this frame does not model

pros.claim: A written mortality map turns any new symptom into a short suspect list instead of a guessing game
pros.example: when a build bath's deposit warms toward brassy, the map points at the copper strike two stations upstream before anyone reaches for treatment chemicals

cons.claim: The map is a model, not a measurement, and over-trusting it anchors diagnosis on the expected suspect
cons.example: a bench blamed rack drag-in for weeks of gray deposits while a corroding heater sheath below the waterline was the actual iron source

failure_modes: treating bath death as a single-event story and hunting one villain while accumulation continues
mapping only the gold tanks and ignoring support tanks and rinses that feed them
letting the map go stale after a product, rack route or layout change
acceptance_tests: every production tank has a written entry listing at least its drag-in sources, its in-situ aging products and its drag-out destinations, and the entry was reviewed after the most recent line change
revisit_triggers: a tank, product or rack route is added, moved or removed
a post-mortem finds a contamination route the map never listed

nodes.definition: Anchor every lifecycle number and treatment action to the specific commercial product's technical data sheet and its supplier's service guidance: what contamination the product is stated to tolerate, which treatments it sanctions (filtration media, carbon, dummying, carbonate removal), what must be re-dosed afterwards, and when the correct move is a sample to the supplier lab rather than another bench remedy. The bench may cite published handbook-class ranges as classes - carbonate dulling bands, tens-of-ppm metallic sensitivity - but never converts them into the shop's own asserted limits; the TDS governs, the log records, and anything the TDS is silent on is a supplier question, not an invented number.

included: TDS and supplier service guidance as the governing sources for tolerances and treatments
handbook-class ranges cited only as labeled classes
the supplier-escalation route for anything the documentation does not answer
excluded: routine in-window analysis and replenishment doctrine (sibling analysis KB)
asserting any numeric limit as universal fact
formulating or modifying chemistry outside what the supplier sanctions

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a revised TDS, a new supplier service bulletin, or a documented treatment outcome that contradicts the current sheet

pros.claim: TDS-first governance keeps every treatment inside what the product is actually built to survive
pros.example: a supplier's service sheet for a sulfite gold names its sanctioned carbon pack and warns off a generic powder treatment that would have crashed the bath's stabilizer

cons.claim: Strict deference slows the bench when the TDS is thin and the supplier is slow to answer
cons.example: a quarantined build bath sat idle three days waiting for supplier confirmation that dummying was sanctioned for its zinc signature

failure_modes: promoting a handbook class into a house limit and defending it as fact
running a treatment the TDS never sanctioned because a forum post recommended it
skipping the supplier escalation and burning treatment cycles on guesswork
acceptance_tests: each gold and support product on the line has a lifecycle sheet naming its sanctioned treatment classes and its supplier contact, and no shop document states a contamination limit that is not traceable to the TDS, the supplier or an explicitly labeled handbook class
revisit_triggers: the supplier revises a TDS or service bulletin
a product on the line is substituted for another
a treatment outcome contradicts what the documentation predicted

nodes.definition: Hold the one non-negotiable line through every lifecycle act: cyanide-bearing solutions and acids are never mixed, never stored together and never share a drain, because acid contact with any cyanide stream liberates hydrogen cyanide - and lifecycle work is exactly where the two are most likely to meet, in rinse routing, treatment transfers, spent-solution staging and disposal handling. The node makes segregation a design input, not a poster: separate labeled zones, drains, tools and spill paths for cyanide and acid streams; every cyanide-bearing solution and rinse kept alkaline at all times; storage locked, labeled and compliant with the jurisdiction's rules; and formal cyanide training plus emergency readiness treated as prerequisites this KB points to and never improvises.

included: the never-mix, never-store-together, never-share-a-drain rule applied to lifecycle streams
alkalinity maintenance on every cyanide-bearing solution and rinse
segregated zones, drains, tools and spill paths as lifecycle design inputs
formal-training and jurisdiction-rule pointers
excluded: full chemical-safety operations, PPE programs and emergency procedure (safety specialist and formal training)
destruction chemistry execution (trained, authorized operators only)
any improvised procedure whatsoever

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a jurisdiction rule change, a layout change, or any near-miss report involving cyanide and acid stream proximity

pros.claim: Designing segregation into the lifecycle layout removes the lethal failure mode instead of relying on daily vigilance
pros.example: a review of a planned drag-out rinse relocation caught that its overflow path ran toward the pickle drain before a drop was ever spilled

cons.claim: Absolute segregation duplicates equipment and floor space that a small shop can barely spare
cons.example: two spill kits, two labeled tool sets and two staging shelves where one crowded bench used to serve everything

failure_modes: a cyanide rinse and an acid rinse quietly sharing a drain line installed years apart
spent solution staged 'temporarily' next to incompatible chemistry during a busy week
letting a cyanide stream's alkalinity drift downward while it waits for disposal
acceptance_tests: a walk of the line shows no cyanide stream and no acid stream sharing a zone, drain, tool set or spill path; every stored lifecycle stream is labeled with its class; alkalinity is maintained and checked on stored cyanide streams; training records and the jurisdiction check are on file
revisit_triggers: any layout, drain or storage change
a new treatment, recovery or disposal step is introduced
the jurisdiction's workplace or hazmat rules change

nodes.definition: Control the solution film that every part, rack and tool carries into a tank from the station before it: prior-tank chemistry, rinse water of whatever quality the cascade last held, buffing-compound and maskant residues that survived prep, and the corrosion products of the rack itself. Drag-in is the dominant route by which foreign metals and organics enter a gold bath, so the bench engineers it down - adequate inter-tank rinsing, drain-dwell before transfer, no tools shared between chemically hostile tanks, racks maintained so cracked coatings do not ferry one tank's solution into the next - and treats any change in upstream chemistry as a change in every downstream bath's exposure.

included: drag-in as the dominant contamination ingress mechanism
the control requirements it imposes: rinse adequacy, drain-dwell, dedicated tools, rack maintenance
upstream chemistry changes as downstream exposure changes
excluded: rinse cascade design as prep procedure (surface-preparation specialist)
run-level transfer choreography (process-execution specialist)
the deposit-symptom reading of what got in (signature nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a verified signature traced to a drag-in route, or an upstream chemistry change altering what can ride in

pros.claim: Drag-in control is the cheapest bath-life extension available on the line
pros.example: a few seconds of drain-dwell and one refreshed rinse between nickel and gold spare the build bath a nickel dose on every single rack

cons.claim: Rinse and dwell discipline slows every transfer and the temptation to skip it grows with the backlog
cons.example: on a flash-refresh day the crew shortcuts the intermediate rinse for one batch and the strike absorbs a week's worth of cleaner in an afternoon

failure_modes: rinse tanks silently degrading into contamination reservoirs because nobody owns their change-out
one dropper, stirrer or thermometer wandering between hostile tanks
an upstream product substitution nobody flagged to the gold-tank owner
acceptance_tests: each hostile tank pair on the line has a defined rinse step, a drain-dwell habit and a no-shared-tools rule, and rack coatings are on an inspection cadence
revisit_triggers: an upstream bath or prep product changes
a signature verdict names drag-in as the source

nodes.definition: Manage the reverse stream: every rack that leaves a gold tank carries bath on it, and at small scale that film is the shop's largest single gold loss - the corpus's blunt phrasing is that drag-out often exceeds the gold actually deposited. The mechanics are simple and merciless: withdrawal speed, drainage geometry, part shape and drain-dwell seconds set the volume, and whatever is not dripped back over the tank or captured in a static drag-out rinse is gold headed for the drain and cyanide headed for the waste bill. The bench designs drag-out handling as an economic system - slow withdrawal, dwell over the tank, a dedicated static drag-out rinse whose gold-bearing content returns to the bath as evaporation make-up while the bath is healthy - and books the captured value in the lifecycle ledger.

included: drag-out as simultaneous gold loss and hazardous-stream generation
drain-dwell, withdrawal and capture mechanics as an economic system
the static drag-out rinse and its health-conditional return rule
excluded: run-level rack handling instructions (process-execution specialist)
recovery method classes for flowing rinses (rinse-recovery node)
waste characterization paperwork (safety specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a ledger comparison of estimated drag-out loss against captured recovery that shows the system leaking

pros.claim: A static drag-out rinse converts the worst loss route into a recovery stream with three buckets and a rule
pros.example: the first rinse after the build bath quietly accumulates gold all month and tops the bath back up as evaporation makes room

cons.claim: Everything the rack carried out comes back with the returned rinse, contamination included
cons.example: a drag-out rinse that also served a re-racking bench returned buffing dust to the build bath along with the gold

failure_modes: no drain-dwell habit, so the loss is continuous and invisible
the drag-out rinse plumbed to a drain by someone who thought it was just water
returning drag-out rinse to a quarantined bath and re-dosing it with its own poison
acceptance_tests: every gold tank has a drag-out capture route, a drain-dwell habit and a written return rule conditioned on bath health status
revisit_triggers: the gold-loss estimate in the ledger exceeds what capture is recovering
a bath's health status changes while returns are active

nodes.definition: Audit the hardware that lives in the solution: insoluble anodes shedding or dissolving traces over their service life (stainless steel contributing iron, chromium and nickel where it stands in for platinized titanium), rack coatings cracked enough to soak up one tank and bleed it into the next, contact clips and wires of attacked metal, heater sheaths and thermometer stems corroding invisibly below the waterline, and the classic catastrophe - a dropped part lying on the tank bottom, dissolving for days. The bath attacks whatever it touches, so the bench chooses compatible materials per the product documentation, inspects everything wet on a cadence, and sweeps the tank after any lost piece rather than hoping it was retrieved.

included: anodes, racks, contacts, heaters and instruments as slow contamination sources
lost parts as acute in-tank sources
material compatibility and inspection cadence as the controls
excluded: anode selection at line design time (sibling selection KB)
rectifier and contact electrical behavior (process-execution specialist)
the symptom-side reading of what the hardware shed (signature nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an inspection or post-mortem tracing a signature to a specific piece of wet hardware

pros.claim: A short wet-hardware inspection cadence catches slow sources years before they would announce themselves in the deposit
pros.example: a monthly rack-tip check finds plastisol cracked at the bend, still ferrying electrocleaner into the gold in amounts no analysis had flagged yet

cons.claim: Inspection produces nothing visible when it works, so it is the first discipline dropped under load
cons.example: pulling, rinsing and drying anodes for examination on a Friday afternoon feels like unpaid theater until the quarter it prevents

failure_modes: a dropped part written off as 'probably fished out' while it dissolves
assuming an insoluble anode is inert forever instead of a slow trace source
replacing a failed heater with whatever sheath material was in the drawer
acceptance_tests: every rack, anode, contact, heater and in-tank instrument appears on an inspection register with a cadence and a material-compatibility note, and a tank sweep is logged after any lost piece
revisit_triggers: a gradual signature appears with a clean event log
any hardware substitution in or over a tank

nodes.definition: Guard the quiet ingress routes: make-up water and shop air. Evaporation leaves behind everything the water brought - hardness minerals, chlorides, whatever the tap carries that day - concentrating in the bath with every top-up, which is why the make-up water class the TDS names (deionized or reverse-osmosis grade) is a lifecycle control and not a nicety. Air contributes too: buffing-wheel dust and polishing-compound aerosols settle into open tanks, mist migrates from neighboring solutions, and carbon dioxide absorption feeds carbonate growth in alkaline baths. Covers on idle tanks, a bench layout that separates dusty mechanical work from open chemistry, and one fixed, logged water source close these routes for almost nothing.

included: make-up water quality as a cumulative ingress mechanism
airborne dust, aerosol and cross-tank mist ingress
covers, layout separation and a fixed logged water source as controls
excluded: rinse water quality inside the prep cascade (surface-preparation specialist)
ventilation as a safety system (safety specialist)
carbonate chemistry itself (carbonate node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a water analysis, source change or layout change that alters what these routes can deliver

pros.claim: Water and air controls are one-time decisions that keep paying without daily discipline
pros.example: a lidded tank and a labeled DI carboy at the bench mean the weekend top-up cannot quietly become a tap-water event

cons.claim: DI or RO capacity and cover handling cost money and small habits, so shops defer them until a bath teaches the lesson
cons.example: in a heat wave the DI tank ran dry and someone topped up the gold with tap rather than lose the afternoon

failure_modes: evaporation top-ups from an unverified water source
buffing bench and open tanks sharing air in a one-room shop
covers left off idle tanks because they are 'about to be used'
acceptance_tests: the make-up water class per TDS is documented, the source is logged per top-up, and idle tanks are covered per the bench's written habit
revisit_triggers: a water source, purifier or shop layout change
a haze signature with no other candidate route

nodes.definition: Read foreign metals from what the deposit does: the handbook class puts meaningful degradation at the tens-of-ppm level for the usual suspects, and each has a habit - copper pulling color toward red or brassy, iron graying and dulling the deposit and feeding roughness, lead and zinc showing as dark, smutty or brittle deposits with poor ductility. The map runs symptom to candidate metal to likely source - which upstream tank, which fixture, which dropped part - and every candidate is confirmed by an analysis method class - plated coupon plus XRF, Hull cell panel pattern, or a supplier lab metals scan - never by symptom alone, because signatures overlap and treating the wrong metal wastes the bath's remaining life.

included: symptom-to-candidate-metal reading as a class, with color, roughness and ductility habits
source attribution back to the mortality map
verification by coupon-XRF, Hull cell or supplier lab before any call is final
excluded: asserted numeric ppm limits (TDS and labeled handbook classes only)
customer-piece defect disposition (quality specialist)
the dummying remedy itself (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a verified case where the deposit symptom and the confirmed metal disagree with the map's current reading

pros.claim: A symptom map plus mandatory verification finds the metal fast without ever trusting the symptom alone
pros.example: a brassy shift plus the map's pointer to the copper strike, confirmed by a coupon XRF, beat a week of trial dosing

cons.claim: Signatures overlap and a map read confidently without verification is worse than no map
cons.example: gray-and-dull was called iron from the rack hooks when a supplier scan showed lead from an antique solder job dissolved in the strike

failure_modes: treating on symptom alone because the map 'was obvious'
verifying the metal but never chasing its source, so it returns
quoting the tens-of-ppm handbook class as if it were this product's measured limit
acceptance_tests: every metallic verdict in the log names its symptom evidence, its verification method class and its suspected source, and no treatment was launched on symptom alone
revisit_triggers: a supplier lab result contradicts the map's reading
a new upstream chemistry introduces a metal the map does not cover

nodes.definition: Recognize the organic family by its deposit story: dulling and haze on a bath whose analysis still sits in-window, pitting where films cling to the surface, streaks and cloudy patterns, stubborn foam at the solution line, and the slow loss of brightness as aged additive fragments accumulate. The sources are mundane - cleaner and buffing-compound carryover, maskant and tape residues, mold release on castings, oil from a pump or an ungloved hand, and the bath's own additives decomposing under electrolysis. Organics are the carbon-treatable class, which is exactly why the diagnosis matters: carbon strips organics and additives alike, so calling a metallic or carbonate problem organic burns a treatment cycle and leaves the real killer in the tank.

included: haze, pitting, streaking, foam and brightness-loss as the organic symptom family
carryover, residues, oils and additive breakdown as the source family
in-window analysis as the tell that separates organics from concentration problems
excluded: the carbon treatment procedure itself (its own node)
additive dosing and balance doctrine (sibling analysis KB)
pitting caused by current-density or agitation faults (process-execution specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a confirmed organic source that the symptom map or source family did not predict

pros.claim: The in-window-but-dull pattern narrows the field to organics or carbonate in one step
pros.example: a build bath titrating perfectly while hazing its deposits sent the bench straight to the organic-versus-carbonate branch instead of another replenishment round

cons.claim: Organic symptoms mimic aging and mild parameter faults, and the class hides its specific culprit
cons.example: a foam line blamed on cleaner drag-in was actually a failing filter pump seal weeping oil, found only when the foam outlived a cleaner change

failure_modes: carbon-treating a carbonate problem because both read as dull
finding the class but never the source, so the treatment becomes a subscription
ignoring foam and surface film because the deposit still passes
acceptance_tests: every organic verdict records the in-window analysis that cleared concentration causes, the symptom evidence, and a source hypothesis to be closed or confirmed after treatment
revisit_triggers: a treatment cycle that does not clear the symptom
a new organic-bearing material (compound, maskant, tape, oil) enters the shop

nodes.definition: Treat carbonate as the built-in clock of alkaline cyanide gold baths: it forms in service from cyanide oxidation and from carbon dioxide absorbed out of the air, so even a perfectly protected bath ages toward the same dull, hazy, low-efficiency end. Published practice names service-band classes above which deposits dull and efficiency sags, and names the remedy classes - chilling the bath so carbonate crystallizes out (freeze-out) or a partial dump-and-rebuild per supplier guidance; air agitation of cyanide baths is avoided partly because sparging accelerates exactly this growth, on top of its mist hazard. Because carbonate is aging rather than contamination, its signature - a good bath going slowly dull while metal and additive analysis stay in-window - is a lifecycle milestone, and its trajectory belongs in the age ledger next to metal turnovers.

included: carbonate formation as inevitable in-service aging of alkaline baths
the slow-dulling in-window signature and its handbook-class service bands
freeze-out and partial-rebuild as supplier-guided remedy classes
carbonate trajectory as ledger content
excluded: carbonate titration mechanics (sibling analysis KB)
asserting a numeric service limit as fact (TDS and labeled handbook class only)
acid-gold aging chemistry (different family; supplier documentation governs)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a carbonate trend or remedy outcome inconsistent with the published aging story for this product class

pros.claim: Knowing the clock is running reframes dulling as a milestone to plan for instead of an emergency
pros.example: a bench watching its carbonate trend booked a freeze-out weekend a month ahead instead of losing a Friday to a surprise dull batch

cons.claim: The aging story can absorb blame that belongs to a real contamination event
cons.example: a dull turn called 'just carbonate' delayed by two weeks the discovery of a weeping pump seal that was the actual cause

failure_modes: carbon-treating carbonate dullness and wondering why nothing changed
running an improvised freeze-out without supplier guidance and crashing other bath constituents
never logging carbonate, so every dulling event starts the investigation from zero
acceptance_tests: the carbonate trend of each alkaline gold bath is tracked in the ledger and every remedy applied is a supplier-sanctioned class with its outcome recorded
revisit_triggers: a carbonate reading jumps faster than service alone explains
supplier guidance for the product's carbonate handling changes

nodes.definition: Run the discipline that decides what a sick bath actually has before anything is dosed, filtered or dumped: first confirm with the analysis KB's methods that the TDS-window parameters are not the story - gold content, pH, temperature, additive balance - then split the remainder across the three lifecycle classes, metallic signature, organic signature and carbonate aging, using converging evidence: the symptom's character, the mortality map's live suspects, a Hull cell panel or plated coupon read against a known-good reference, and a supplier lab sample when bench methods disagree. The differential ends in a named, evidence-backed verdict recorded in the log; 'we think it is copper, here is the coupon and the suspected source' is a diagnosis, while 'it looks off, add brightener' is the malpractice this node exists to prevent.

included: the analysis-first gate that clears in-window parameter causes
the three-way split across metallic, organic and carbonate classes
converging-evidence verification and the recorded verdict
supplier lab escalation when bench methods disagree
excluded: the analysis methods' own mechanics (sibling analysis KB)
treatment execution (treatment nodes)
piece-level defect cause trees (quality specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a verified case where the differential's verdict and the treatment outcome disagree, or a supplier lab overturning a bench call

pros.claim: A forced differential prevents the most expensive habit in plating: treating the wrong class
pros.example: the in-window check stopped a carbon treatment that would have stripped additives from a bath whose only fault was a drifted thermostat

cons.claim: The full differential takes hours to days while the tank earns nothing
cons.example: waiting on a supplier metals scan idled the build tank across a promised delivery date, and the customer call was not pleasant

failure_modes: skipping the analysis-first gate and 'treating' simple parameter drift
stopping at the first plausible class without converging evidence
dosing the bath mid-differential and destroying the diagnostic signal
acceptance_tests: every treatment in the log is preceded by a recorded differential verdict naming its class, its converging evidence and its suspected source; any treatment without one is a process violation
revisit_triggers: a treatment outcome contradicts the verdict
bench methods and supplier lab disagree
a new signature class appears that the three-way split does not cover

nodes.definition: The moment a bath becomes credibly suspect, take it out of the customer path: no customer work enters a quarantined tank, in-flight pieces route around it or hold, the static drag-out return to that bath stops, and the tank runs coupons only until the differential lands. Quarantine is cheap insurance against compounding loss - one more rack through a copper-poisoned gold bath converts a bath problem into a rework batch, a broken customer promise and gold spent twice - and it preserves evidence, because dosing a bath 'to see if it helps' destroys the very signal the diagnosis needs. Release from quarantine is earned by a passing verification coupon, never by impatience or the schedule.

included: the customer-work stop, routing hold and drag-out-return stop on suspicion
coupons-only operation during diagnosis
coupon-earned release criteria
excluded: rescheduling and customer communication (business specialist)
the differential itself (its own node)
rework disposition of already-plated pieces (quality specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a quarantine bypassed or released early whose consequences are documented, or a false-alarm rate that argues for adjusting the trigger threshold

pros.claim: Quarantine caps the blast radius of a bad bath at the moment of suspicion
pros.example: holding one afternoon's racks kept a zinc-signature strike from decorating thirty customer pieces with brittle deposits

cons.claim: Every quarantine idles a revenue tank on what may prove a false alarm
cons.example: a haze that turned out to be a drifted thermostat still cost two days of build-tank capacity and a rush-shipped apology

failure_modes: 'one more batch' through a suspect tank because the deadline is real and the contamination is hypothetical
quarantining the bath but leaving the drag-out return running
releasing on a good feeling instead of a passing coupon
acceptance_tests: each quarantine event logs its trigger, the stop actions taken (work, routing, returns), the coupons run, and the passing verification coupon that authorized release
revisit_triggers: a release decision later contradicted by a returning signature
quarantine frequency rising on any one tank

nodes.definition: Run filtration as the bath's continuous kidneys for particulate and as the carrier loop for other treatments: turnover of the tank volume on a supplier-sanctioned cadence, media chosen for chemical compatibility with the product and pre-conditioned per its instructions so a new cartridge does not itself shed or leach, and flow routed so the tank sweeps rather than channels. Filtration answers suspended solids - dust, carbonate crystals, anode particles, dragged-in polishing debris - and prevents the roughness and inclusion defects they seed, but it removes neither dissolved metals nor most dissolved organics, a limit the bench must respect when matching treatment to class. Spent cartridges from gold tanks are gold-bearing and, on a cyanide line, cyanide-contaminated: they enter the recovery and regulated-waste streams, never the trash.

included: particulate removal and turnover as the mechanism
media compatibility and pre-conditioning per supplier instructions
the dissolved-contaminant limit of the method
spent cartridges as gold-bearing regulated items
excluded: agitation and flow as deposit-quality parameters (sibling analysis KB)
carbon treatment chemistry (its own node)
waste manifest execution (safety specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a filtration-attributed defect change, positive or negative, documented in the log after a media or cadence adjustment

pros.claim: Continuous filtration quietly deletes the whole roughness-defect family before it reaches a deposit
pros.example: after a filter was added to a strike-side loop the recurring gritty patches on ring shoulders simply stopped appearing

cons.claim: The wrong media or an unconditioned cartridge turns the remedy into a contamination source
cons.example: a bargain cartridge with an incompatible binder hazed a sulfite bath within a day of installation

failure_modes: expecting filtration to fix a dissolved-metal signature
a cartridge left in service until it channels and stops filtering
spent gold-tank cartridges discarded as ordinary trash, losing metal and breaking waste rules
acceptance_tests: each filtered tank lists its media class, its pre-conditioning step and its change-out cadence per supplier guidance, and spent cartridges are logged into the recovery or regulated-waste stream
revisit_triggers: a symptom appearing immediately after a media change
supplier guidance revising the sanctioned media or cadence

nodes.definition: Apply activated carbon as the organic-class remedy it is: adsorption of dissolved organic contamination and aged additive fragments, run per supplier guidance - normally in the filtration loop as cartridges or packs, since loose powder circulating while insoluble anodes run is a known self-inflicted wound - followed by the step benches forget: carbon strips the additive package along with the contamination, so the bath is re-dosed per the TDS and verified by coupon or Hull cell panel before customer work resumes. Dose, contact time and frequency are the product supplier's numbers, not folklore; and a bath that needs carbon on a rhythm is telling the lifecycle loop that an organic ingress route is still open.

included: carbon adsorption as the organic-class remedy
in-loop packs versus the loose-powder hazard
mandatory re-additive per TDS and coupon verification after treatment
treatment frequency as a symptom of an open ingress route
excluded: additive chemistry and dosing doctrine (sibling analysis KB)
carbonate and metallic remedies (their own nodes)
supplier-unsanctioned treatment improvisation (TDS boundary)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a treatment log showing outcomes that contradict the supplier's guidance for this product, or a recurring-treatment rhythm indicating an open source

pros.claim: Carbon restores an organically fouled bath at a fraction of replacement cost when the class call is right
pros.example: one sanctioned carbon pack cycle cleared a haze that had been blamed on age, and the after-coupon matched the retained good reference

cons.claim: Every carbon pass strips brighteners and wetters with the contamination, and the forgotten re-dose ruins the next runs
cons.example: a bath came out of treatment clean and promptly plated matte for a day because nobody re-dosed the additive package per the TDS

failure_modes: loose carbon powder shed into a tank with insoluble anodes running
treatment without the differential's organic verdict, wasting the cycle on the wrong class
skipping the re-additive step or the verification coupon and releasing customer work blind
acceptance_tests: every carbon treatment logs its supplier-sanctioned form and dose, the re-additive step per TDS, and a passing verification coupon before customer work resumed
revisit_triggers: carbon treatments recurring on a rhythm on the same bath
supplier guidance changing the sanctioned carbon form or dose

nodes.definition: Use dummy plating as the metallic-class remedy: a corrugated or large-area scrap cathode run at deliberately low current density so the more easily reduced contaminant metals plate out preferentially while the bath's gold mostly stays in solution. It is slow, consumes tank time and some gold, works better on some contaminants than others, and can fail outright when the contaminant will not deposit at the chosen conditions - so the run is bracketed by evidence: a before-coupon that fixes the signature, supplier confirmation that dummying is sanctioned for this product and this metal, and an after-coupon that decides success. Two failed cycles on the same verified signature is not an argument for a third; it is the regenerate-or-replace decision arriving.

included: low-current-density scavenging onto sacrificial cathodes as the mechanism
before-and-after coupon bracketing and supplier sanction
the two-failed-cycles escalation rule
the dummy cathode as a gold-bearing recovery item
excluded: current-density arithmetic and rectifier work (process-execution specialist)
which metals respond at which conditions as asserted numbers (supplier guidance)
the economics decision it escalates to (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: accumulated before-after coupon pairs showing which signatures this bath's dummying actually clears

pros.claim: A successful dummy cycle removes the poison without discarding the gold inventory locked in the bath
pros.example: an overnight corrugated-cathode run pulled a copper signature below symptom level and the build bath went back to work with its full gold content

cons.claim: Dummying is slow, gold-consuming and unreliable across contaminant types, and hope keeps it running past its evidence
cons.example: three consecutive weekend dummy runs on a lead signature changed nothing a coupon could detect while the tank earned nothing

failure_modes: running the dummy at too high a current density and simply burning gold onto the cathode
declaring success by eye instead of by after-coupon
discarding the loaded dummy cathode instead of routing it to recovery
acceptance_tests: every dummy cycle logs its before-coupon, its supplier sanction, its conditions class, its after-coupon verdict, and the recovery routing of the loaded cathode
revisit_triggers: an after-coupon showing no change on a verified signature
supplier guidance revising which signatures dummying is sanctioned for

nodes.definition: Run the gold strike as the fuse it is designed to be: a small, low-metal, high-complexant bath that takes the first hit of every rack - absorbing drag-in metals while doing its adhesion duty - precisely so the expensive build bath behind it stays clean. The doctrine is sacrificial: tolerate contamination in the strike until its deposits stain or its behavior turns, then dump and remake, recovering the modest gold content from the spent strike; its small volume is what makes remake cheap, and 'saving' a contaminated strike by dosing it defeats its architectural purpose while inviting the contamination one tank deeper into the line. A shop that finds its build bath contaminated should first ask what its strike was doing when the poison walked past.

included: the strike's sacrificial contamination-absorbing role in front of the build bath
dump-and-remake doctrine with gold recovery from the spent strike
the stain-or-behavior trigger for remake
excluded: strike selection and its adhesion chemistry (sibling selection KB)
strike operating parameters (TDS and sibling analysis KB)
build-bath treatment decisions (differential and economics nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: remake-interval and build-bath-contamination trends that show the buffer doing or failing its job

pros.claim: A sacrificial strike converts unavoidable drag-in into a cheap scheduled remake instead of a build-bath catastrophe
pros.example: the strike quietly ate a season of mixed-substrate drag-in and was remade twice for less than one build-bath rescue would have cost

cons.claim: Remakes cost real gold, chemistry and downtime, and the frugal instinct to nurse the strike is strong
cons.example: a bench kept dosing a staining strike for a month to defer the remake, and the build bath collected the overflow contamination it existed to prevent

failure_modes: dosing a contaminated strike to postpone its remake
letting strike deposits stain visibly before anyone acts
dumping the spent strike without recovering its gold content
acceptance_tests: each strike remake logs its trigger evidence, the gold-recovery routing of the spent volume, and the remake date in the ledger
revisit_triggers: strike remake intervals shortening, indicating rising drag-in load
a build-bath contamination event that implies the strike stopped buffering

nodes.definition: Keep each bath's biography separately from the routine control log: date and composition class at make-up, cumulative ampere-hours and metal turnovers, every treatment - carbon, freeze-out, dummy cycles - with its trigger and outcome, every contamination event and its post-mortem, the carbonate trajectory, and the running cost the bath has absorbed. The routine analysis log answers 'is this bath in its window today'; the age ledger answers 'what has this bath lived through and what will it likely do next' - and it is the evidence base without which the regenerate-versus-replace decision degenerates into mood. A ledger entry costs a minute; a replacement decision made blind costs a bath, or worse, keeps a dying one in the customer path.

included: make-up record, ampere-hours, metal turnovers and treatment history per bath
contamination events, post-mortems and carbonate trajectory
accumulated cost as decision evidence
excluded: the daily analysis log and its replenishment entries (sibling analysis KB)
job-level run logging (process-execution specialist)
the decision mechanism the ledger feeds (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a lifecycle decision that the ledger could or could not support, revealing which fields earn their keep

pros.claim: The ledger converts the replace decision from argument into arithmetic
pros.example: when the build bath dulled again, two minutes with its ledger showed three treatments in five months on a rising cost curve, and the remake decision made itself

cons.claim: A second book invites neglect precisely because the routine log already exists
cons.example: a shop kept immaculate titration records while nobody could say how many turnovers the strike had lived, which was the question that mattered

failure_modes: opening the ledger at first illness instead of at make-up, so early history is fiction
recording treatments without their outcomes, hiding the recurrence pattern
merging ledger and control log until neither answers its question
acceptance_tests: every bath on the line has a ledger opened at make-up with age, treatment and event history current enough to answer the regenerate-versus-replace question today
revisit_triggers: any treatment, contamination event or remake
a decision that needed a ledger fact the ledger did not hold

nodes.definition: Decide a sick or aged bath's fate by mechanism, not sentiment: on one side the full cost of another treatment cycle - chemistry, tank downtime, the coupon runs, and the probability the signature returns because the source or the age remains - and on the other the cost of replacement - new make-up chemistry and rebuild labor, minus the gold recovered from the retired solution, minus the risk retired with it. Structural facts do most of the deciding: small volumes with modest gold, like strikes, tip to replace almost immediately; large build baths with heavy gold inventories earn real treatment effort; and repeated returns of the same verified signature, carbonate at the end of its service class, or behavior contradicting the TDS tip any bath toward replacement. The decision and its numbers go into the ledger, because next year's decision will want them.

included: treatment-cycle cost and recurrence probability versus remake cost net of recovery
the structural tipping facts: volume, gold inventory, repeat signatures, end-of-service aging
the recorded decision as ledger content
excluded: executing the recovery and disposal it triggers (recovery and handoff nodes)
invented dollar figures stated as fact (mechanism and the shop's own logged costs only)
the strike's special always-replace doctrine (strike node, which overrides this mechanism)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: ledger outcomes of past decisions - treatments that held versus signatures that returned - recalibrating the mechanism's recurrence estimates

pros.claim: A costed mechanism ends the bath-nursing spiral that eats months of marginal quality
pros.example: putting downtime and recurrence probability into the comparison showed the 'cheap' third treatment was the most expensive option on the table

cons.claim: The inputs are estimates and the mechanism can dress a guess in arithmetic
cons.example: a recurrence probability pulled from optimism justified one more treatment that the returning signature refunded in two weeks

failure_modes: counting chemistry cost but not downtime and recurrence risk, biasing every decision toward treatment
ignoring the gold-recovery credit and overpricing replacement
leaving the decision unrecorded so the same debate reruns from zero next quarter
acceptance_tests: every regenerate-or-replace decision in the ledger names the cost elements compared, the structural facts applied and the outcome, and repeated-signature baths show an escalation rather than an endless treatment loop
revisit_triggers: gold price movement or refiner terms shifting the recovery credit
a treatment outcome changing the recurrence estimate
supplier guidance redefining what the product can be treated for

nodes.definition: Extract the metal before the molecule dies: a retired gold bath or spent strike still holds real gold, and recovery - electrowinning or extended dummy plating onto recoverable cathodes in-house where the line is lawfully equipped and trained, or the refiner route where the solution ships to a licensed processor and returns as a documented credit - happens before any destruction or disposal step, because value destroyed is unrecoverable and the refiner's paper trail doubles as the compliance paper trail. Cyanide-bearing solutions stay alkaline, labeled and segregated throughout; in-house recovery on such solutions is a trained-operator, licensed-line activity and never an improvisation; and the choice between in-house and refiner is itself economics - gold content, labor, hazard-holding time and the refiner's terms.

included: recovery-before-destruction sequencing on every retired gold-bearing solution
electrowinning and extended dummying as in-house classes where lawful and equipped
the refiner route and its credit-and-compliance paper trail
the in-house-versus-refiner economics
excluded: destruction chemistry execution and manifest paperwork (safety specialist, trained channels)
refining metallurgy itself (the refiner's trade)
rinse-stream recovery (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: settlement reports and recovery yields that calibrate what each route actually returns for this shop's volumes

pros.claim: Recovery turns a disposal liability into a documented asset with the paperwork compliance wants anyway
pros.example: a retired strike shipped to the refiner came back as a credit note and a settlement report that slotted straight into the waste file

cons.claim: In-house recovery extends the time hazardous solution sits in the shop and tempts under-equipped improvisation
cons.example: a bench electrowinning a spent cyanide bath 'over a few weeks' accumulated exactly the storage condition its license never contemplated

failure_modes: destroying or shipping solution before the recovery decision was made and documented
improvised recovery on cyanide-bearing solution by untrained hands
an undocumented refiner handoff that loses both the credit and the compliance trail
acceptance_tests: every retired gold-bearing solution shows a recovery decision (in-house or refiner) taken and documented before destruction or disposal, with cyanide streams alkaline, labeled and segregated throughout, and the credit or settlement filed
revisit_triggers: refiner terms or gold price shifting the in-house-versus-refiner balance
a change in the shop's equipment, training or license status

nodes.definition: Treat rinse water as a gold-bearing stream with a status, never as water: the static drag-out rinse is deliberately concentrated capture whose content returns to a healthy bath as evaporation make-up or joins the recovery stream when the bath is quarantined or retired; flowing rinses further down the cascade carry less but not nothing, and recovery method classes exist for them - ion-exchange resin columns and electrolytic recovery cells - whose loaded media are themselves gold-bearing regulated items sent onward for refining. Every rinse in the cyanide train remains a cyanide-class stream until treated: never to a general drain, never meeting the acid rinses, so rinse recovery design is simultaneously a gold-economics exercise and a segregation exercise.

included: rinse status tracking tied to bath health
ion-exchange and electrolytic recovery cells as method classes for flowing rinses
loaded media as gold-bearing regulated items
cyanide-class handling of every rinse in the cyanide train
excluded: rinse cascade design for cleanliness (surface-preparation specialist)
discharge permitting and treatment execution (safety specialist, jurisdiction rules)
the drag-out capture mechanics (drag-out node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: recovered-gold accounting from rinse streams versus the hardware and handling cost, per season

pros.claim: Rinse recovery collects gold the shop already paid for and shrinks the hazardous discharge burden at the same time
pros.example: a small resin column on the flowing rinse quietly accumulated a refinable load over a season while the discharge volume needing treatment fell

cons.claim: Recovery hardware and media add cost and a new regulated item to manage
cons.example: the loaded resin is not trash and not product; it sits in the waste file as one more labeled, manifest-bound container

failure_modes: a rinse treated as plain water and plumbed to a drain
returning drag-out rinse to a bath whose status changed
loaded recovery media discarded or forgotten in storage
acceptance_tests: every rinse tank carries a status tied to its bath, cyanide-train rinses are segregated end to end, and loaded recovery media are logged as gold-bearing regulated items with a refining route
revisit_triggers: a bath status change while returns are active
discharge rules or recovery-media economics changing

nodes.definition: Close a bath's life the regulated way: after recovery, the remaining solution, the sludges, the spent filters and the loaded carbon are characterized waste classes, labeled and stored inside the segregation rules, and they leave the shop only by sanctioned routes - cyanide destruction of the alkaline-chlorination class executed only by trained, equipped, authorized operators, or a licensed hazardous-waste handler with manifest paperwork - never acidified, never sewered untreated, with the jurisdiction's discharge and hazmat rules verified current rather than remembered. This node is the KB's hard boundary: it names the obligation classes and hands execution to the safety-and-waste specialist and to formal training; a bench that finds itself improvising a destruction procedure has already left the map.

included: characterization, labeling and compliant storage of every end-of-life stream
the sanctioned exit routes: authorized destruction classes or licensed handler with manifest
the never-acidify, never-sewer-untreated line
jurisdiction verification as a live obligation
excluded: destruction procedure execution (trained, authorized channels only)
manifest and permit paperwork mechanics (safety specialist)
recovery itself (upstream node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a jurisdiction rule change, a handler change, or any audit finding on an end-of-life stream

pros.claim: A named, sanctioned exit route for every stream means retirement day is logistics, not decisions
pros.example: when the build bath finally retired, every stream - solution, filters, carbon - already had a labeled container class and a handler on file

cons.claim: Licensed disposal is expensive and slow enough to tempt a shop into deferral or shortcuts
cons.example: a drum awaiting pickup occupied the segregated store for a quarter, and the temptation to 'just treat it ourselves' had to be formally declined

failure_modes: an unauthorized bench attempt at destruction chemistry
spent streams accumulating unlabeled 'until there is enough to ship'
assuming last year's jurisdiction rules still hold
acceptance_tests: every end-of-life stream in the log shows its characterization class, its labeled storage inside segregation, its sanctioned exit route, and a current jurisdiction check; no destruction step was executed outside trained, authorized channels
revisit_triggers: jurisdiction waste or discharge rules change
the shop's handler, license status or training roster changes

nodes.definition: Make every bath death and every near-miss pay rent: a short post-mortem - what the verified signature was, which route let it in or which milestone ended the bath's economics, what the treatment history cost, what the replacement decision turned on - is folded back into the mortality map, the signature references, the inspection cadences and the prevention checklists, so the successor bath inherits the lesson rather than the fate. Over a year these post-mortems become the shop's own lifecycle dataset: which racks actually fail, which rinse gets skipped under deadline, how many turnovers a build bath really delivers on this bench - knowledge no TDS can supply because it is about this shop, not the product.

included: the per-event post-mortem and its required fields
feeding findings back into map, signatures, cadences and checklists
the accumulating shop-specific lifecycle dataset
excluded: blame assignment and personnel management (shop management)
customer-facing quality reporting (quality specialist)
the decisions the loop feeds (their own nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: evidence that post-mortem lessons are or are not preventing repeat events on this bench

pros.claim: The loop converts each expensive failure into a permanent discount on the next one
pros.example: one post-mortem's finding - re-racking over an open tank - became a checklist line, and that contamination route never fired again

cons.claim: Post-mortems compete with production time exactly when morale after a loss is lowest
cons.example: after dumping a poisoned bath nobody wanted the meeting about it, and the unwritten lesson had to be relearned in spring

failure_modes: post-mortems written but never folded into the working documents
recording only catastrophes and losing the near-miss signal
letting the review decay into ritual with no checklist changes
acceptance_tests: each bath retirement or major contamination event has a post-mortem on file whose findings can be traced to a change in the map, a signature reference, a cadence or a checklist
revisit_triggers: any bath death or major quarantine event
a repeated failure whose earlier post-mortem lesson did not stick

edges.why_related: the drag-in controls are engineered against the ingress routes the mortality map names
drag-out is the egress column of the same per-tank mass balance the frame writes
carbonate is the frame's canonical in-situ aging product, modeled before any signature reading
the age ledger is the mortality model turned into a running per-bath record
once bath death is framed as manageable, the governance question of who owns the numbers must be settled first
the lifecycle streams the frame enumerates are exactly the streams the segregation spine must route
the metallic map's source-attribution step reads directly off the drag-in routes
cleaner, compound and maskant carryover on the drag-in routes is the organic map's leading source family
airborne compound dust and aerosol ingress are organic sources the map must include
the differential's metallic branch is the map plus its verification discipline
the differential's organic branch relies on the map's in-window-but-dull tell and source families
the differential must be able to call slow in-window dulling as aging rather than contamination
quarantine is triggered by credible suspicion and released by the differential's verified verdict
the economics decision requires the differential's named class and recurrence evidence as input
dummying is only launched against a verified metallic signature the map produced
carbon treatment is the remedy reserved for the organic class the map identifies
the strike's fuse role exists because drag-in cannot be engineered to zero
the ledger supplies the treatment history, age and cost curve the decision mechanism consumes
a replace verdict is what turns a bath into a recoverable spent solution
the drag-out capture system defines what gold the rinse streams hold and where
media class, pre-conditioning and turnover cadence come from the product's documentation
each decision's stated reasons are the raw material of the post-mortem that follows
carbon form, dose, contact time and the re-additive package are the supplier's numbers, never bench folklore
dummying proceeds only where the supplier sanctions it for this product and this metal
recovery on cyanide-bearing solution stays alkaline, labeled, segregated and trained-operator-only throughout
cyanide-train rinses never share a drain, container or route with acid streams at any recovery stage
a long quarantine starves the economics toward hasty replacement, while replace-pressure tempts early release of a suspect bath
edges.resolution_rule: quarantine integrity wins: no early release to dodge a replacement decision and no replacement declared just to end a hold; the differential's verdict plus the coupon evidence must close before the economics mechanism runs

edges.why_related: returning drag-out rinse to the bath conserves gold but also returns every contaminant the rinse collected
edges.resolution_rule: returns run only from a dedicated static drag-out rinse of a bath in healthy status; on quarantine or retirement the return stops and the rinse routes to recovery instead

edges.why_related: the general economics mechanism invites treating a contaminated strike, which the sacrificial doctrine forbids
edges.resolution_rule: the strike is exempt from the regenerate branch: its small volume makes remake cheap and its fuse role makes 'saving' it self-defeating; dump-and-remake with gold recovery wins every time

edges.why_related: maximizing in-house recovery extends how long hazardous spent solution sits in the shop, straining storage and license limits
edges.resolution_rule: compliance wins: recovery happens inside the storage, labeling and license obligation classes, and when in-house extraction would extend non-compliant holding the refiner or licensed-handler route takes the solution with the recovery credit realized there

edges.why_related: shedding anodes, attacked contacts and dissolving lost parts are direct causes of the iron, chromium, nickel and copper signatures the map reads
carbonate reaching the end of its service class is the single most common trigger that forces the replace decision on an alkaline bath
the film a part carries out of one tank is precisely what it carries into the next, so drag-out behavior upstream causes drag-in load downstream
hold first, verify the organic verdict, then treat: carbon never runs on a bath still in open diagnosis
recovery precedes destruction and disposal because value destroyed with the molecule is unrecoverable
post-mortem findings tighten the specific rinse, dwell and tool rules that let the last killer in
the after-coupon of every dummy cycle re-enters the differential to confirm the signature cleared or escalate
both are circulation-loop method classes often sharing the same filter chamber, yet they remove disjoint contaminant classes and must not be confused

conflict_axes.name: gold_value_vs_waste_compliance
conflict_axes.description: Every spent solution, filter and loaded medium holds recoverable gold, and every hour it stays in the shop for extraction is an hour of regulated hazardous holding.
poles: squeeze maximum value in-house before anything ships
move hazardous streams out promptly by sanctioned routes
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: recovery is sequenced before destruction but executed inside the storage, labeling and license obligation classes; when the two collide, the refiner route carries both the value and the compliance

conflict_axes.name: throughput_vs_quarantine
conflict_axes.description: A suspect bath is also a booked bath: holding it protects customers and evidence while the schedule and the promises burn.
poles: keep plating until the problem is proven
hold the tank on credible suspicion
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: quarantine wins whenever customer work or claimed quality is at stake; the cost of one held afternoon is bounded, the cost of a poisoned batch is not

conflict_axes.name: sunk_cost_vs_replacement
conflict_axes.description: A bath that has absorbed three treatments feels too expensive to dump, which is exactly the reasoning that funds a fourth treatment.
poles: protect the investment already made in the bath
cut losses on the evidence and remake
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the ledger's cost curve and the repeat-signature record decide; sunk treatments are evidence for replacement, not against it

conflict_axes.name: treatment_depth_vs_additive_survival
conflict_axes.description: Carbon deep enough to kill the organic contamination also strips the additive package the deposit depends on.
poles: treat hard enough to clear the fouling in one pass
treat gently to preserve the bath's balance
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: run the supplier's sanctioned dose, accept the additive strip as a known cost, re-dose per TDS and verify by coupon before customer work

conflict_axes.name: dragout_return_vs_contamination_return
conflict_axes.description: The static drag-out rinse holds real gold and everything else the racks carried out; returning it feeds the bath both.
poles: return captured drag-out and conserve gold
discard or divert the rinse and protect purity
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: return only from a dedicated static rinse of a bath in healthy status; any quarantine or retirement flips the rinse to the recovery stream

conflict_axes.name: strike_protection_vs_strike_cost
conflict_axes.description: Running the strike as a sacrificial fuse burns gold and chemistry on schedule, and the frugal instinct wants to nurse it instead.
poles: remake the strike the moment it turns
stretch the strike to defer its cost
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the strike's remake cost is the premium on the build bath's insurance; stretching the fuse moves contamination one tank deeper, where everything costs more

conflict_axes.name: bench_remedy_vs_supplier_escalation
conflict_axes.description: The bench can filter, carbon-treat and dummy on its own authority, and every self-run cycle on a wrong or stubborn diagnosis costs a tank-week.
poles: escalate early to the supplier lab
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: one verified treatment cycle per diagnosis; a returning signature or bench methods in disagreement escalate to the supplier rather than fund another guess

conflict_axes.name: prevention_tax_vs_bench_speed
conflict_axes.description: Drain-dwell seconds, refreshed rinses, covers, dedicated tools and inspection cadences all tax every single run to prevent a loss that mostly never happens.
poles: keep the small prevention taxes always on
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the taxes are priced against one killed build bath and stay on; the deadline argument is answered with the ledger's record of what the last shortcut cost

conflict_axes.name: diagnosis_rigor_vs_dosing_reflex
conflict_axes.description: A sick tank begs for action, and adding something feels like work while running coupons feels like delay.
poles: verify the class before any treatment
dose now and observe what changes
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: evidence first, always: dosing mid-diagnosis destroys the signal, and the differential's named verdict is the entry ticket to any remedy

edge_cases.description: A dropped brass finding lies dissolving in the build bath over a weekend and Monday's deposits run brassy
edge_cases.trigger: a piece unaccounted for after a run plus a sudden warm color shift
edge_cases.mitigation: sweep the tank after any lost piece as standing practice; on the color shift, quarantine, run the differential's coupon verification, and log the event with the retrieved part

edge_cases.description: The deposit dulls while every titration and reading sits inside the TDS window
edge_cases.trigger: in-window analysis coinciding with visible deposit degradation
edge_cases.mitigation: this is the differential's organic-versus-carbonate branch by construction: check the carbonate trend in the ledger first, then trial-verify the organic call before any carbon pass

edge_cases.description: Someone returns the static drag-out rinse to a bath that went into quarantine that morning
edge_cases.trigger: a bath status change that the rinse-handling habit does not track
edge_cases.mitigation: tie the rinse's return rule to a visible bath-status tag on the tank; quarantine flips the tag and the rinse routes to recovery until release

edge_cases.description: A newly installed bargain filter cartridge hazes the bath within a day
edge_cases.trigger: a symptom appearing immediately after a media change
edge_cases.mitigation: media compatibility and pre-conditioning per supplier instructions before service; on the haze, pull the cartridge, coupon-verify, and treat the cartridge as the prime suspect rather than the bath's history

edge_cases.description: A carbon pass clears the haze and the next day's work plates matte because the additive package went with it
edge_cases.trigger: treatment done, re-additive step skipped or under-dosed
edge_cases.mitigation: the treatment record is not closed until the TDS re-additive step and a passing verification coupon are logged; customer work waits for both

edge_cases.description: During a heat wave the DI supply runs out and the gold bath gets a tap-water top-up
edge_cases.trigger: make-up water source substituted under time pressure
edge_cases.mitigation: log the event immediately rather than hide it - a known tap event redirects the next haze diagnosis in minutes; then fix the DI capacity so the choice never recurs

edge_cases.description: The bench treats a healthy bath because a thermostat drifted and the symptom mimicked contamination
edge_cases.trigger: a deposit symptom appearing right after a replenishment or equipment event
edge_cases.mitigation: the analysis-first gate exists for this case: the sibling KB's window check must clear parameters before the differential may proceed to contamination classes

edge_cases.description: A spent strike waits for recovery in an unlabeled bucket on a shelf above the pickle station
edge_cases.trigger: any spent cyanide-bearing solution staged outside its segregated, labeled store
edge_cases.mitigation: staging rules are part of segregation: labeled, alkaline, locked, in the cyanide zone, never above or near acid; the walk-the-line acceptance test is designed to catch exactly this

edge_cases.description: A dummy run at too high a current density burns gold onto the cathode while the contamination stays in solution
edge_cases.trigger: an after-coupon showing the signature unchanged after a completed dummy cycle
edge_cases.mitigation: dummying is a low-current-density scavenge class run per supplier sanction; one failed cycle triggers review of conditions, a second failed cycle hands the bath to the economics decision

edge_cases.description: Hue drifts slowly over weeks while the event log shows nothing at all
edge_cases.trigger: gradual signature with a clean event history
edge_cases.mitigation: clean logs plus slow drift point at the hardware that lives in the tank: inspect anodes, contacts, heater sheaths and rack tips, and add whatever was found to the inspection cadence

edge_cases.description: Regeneration looks cheaper than remake until downtime and repeat treatments are counted, and the bath limps for a quarter
edge_cases.trigger: a second treatment cycle on the same bath within a short interval
edge_cases.mitigation: the mechanism prices downtime, recurrence probability and gold lock-up, not chemistry cost alone; the ledger's repeat-treatment record forces the escalation

edge_cases.description: A retired gold-bearing solution is handed to a general hauler uncharacterized, losing the refiner credit and the compliance trail at once
edge_cases.trigger: any bath retirement handled outside the recovery-then-handoff sequence
edge_cases.mitigation: retirement follows the sequence by rule: recovery decision documented first, then characterization, labeled storage and the sanctioned exit route with its paperwork; the ledger closes the bath only when both are filed

workflow.description: For every tank, enumerate drag-in sources, in-situ aging products and drag-out destinations
workflow.gate: every production tank has its three columns filled and reviewed against the current line layout

workflow.action: Bind lifecycle practice to the TDS and supplier guidance
workflow.description: Per product: sanctioned treatments, tolerance statements, re-additive requirements, supplier contact and escalation route
workflow.gate: no invented numeric limit anywhere; every treatment class cites the TDS, the supplier or a labeled handbook class

workflow.action: Design the segregation spine for lifecycle streams
workflow.description: Zones, drains, tools, staging and spill paths for cyanide versus acid streams, with training and jurisdiction pointers
workflow.artifact: segregation map with storage and staging rules
workflow.gate: a physical walk of the line finds no shared drain, zone, tool or staging between cyanide and acid streams

workflow.description: Rinse adequacy, drain-dwell, dedicated tools and rack-coating maintenance per hostile tank pair
workflow.gate: each hostile tank pair has a defined rinse step, a dwell habit and a no-shared-tools rule

workflow.action: Install drag-out capture and its return rule
workflow.description: Withdrawal and dwell habits plus a static drag-out rinse per gold tank, with return conditioned on bath health
workflow.gate: every gold tank has a capture route and a written health-conditional return rule

workflow.action: Register and schedule the wet-hardware audit
workflow.description: Anodes, racks, contacts, heaters and instruments on an inspection cadence, plus make-up water class and idle-tank covers
