workflow.gate: every in-tank item has a cadence and a material-compatibility note; the water class and cover habit are documented

workflow.description: Symptom, candidate metal, likely source and verification method class for each metallic signature the line can produce
workflow.gate: every entry carries a verification method class; no entry authorizes treatment on symptom alone

workflow.action: Author the organic and carbonate signature references
workflow.description: The organic symptom and source families plus the carbonate aging trajectory, with the in-window-but-dull tell
workflow.gate: the chart separates carbon-treatable organics from carbonate aging and names the evidence that distinguishes them

workflow.action: Stand up the differential and quarantine drill
workflow.description: The analysis-first gate, the three-way class split, converging-evidence verification, and the quarantine trigger and release rules
workflow.artifact: bath-side diagnosis flow with quarantine protocol
workflow.gate: no treatment may start without a recorded verdict; no release without a passing coupon

workflow.action: Prove the treatment method classes on coupons
workflow.description: Filtration, carbon and dummying each mapped to their contamination class with before-after coupon bracketing and TDS re-additive steps
workflow.gate: each treatment class ends in re-additive per TDS where applicable and a verification coupon before customer work

workflow.action: Open the age ledger for every bath
workflow.description: Make-up record, ampere-hours, turnovers, treatments with outcomes, events and carbonate trajectory per bath
workflow.gate: every bath has a ledger opened at make-up, current enough to support a regenerate-versus-replace decision today

workflow.description: The decision mechanism, the recovery routes, and the characterized, labeled, sanctioned exit for every end-of-life stream
workflow.gate: the sequence recovery-then-handoff is explicit, every stream has an exit route on file, and the jurisdiction check is dated

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because nothing downstream makes sense without the mortality model, the TDS governance line and the segregation spine; the ingress nodes then establish what actually enters and leaves each tank, which the signature nodes read symptoms against; the differential sits at the hinge because every treatment and every quarantine decision consumes its verdict; the response nodes execute only against verified classes; and the lifecycle nodes close the arc because age accounting, the regenerate-versus-replace mechanism, recovery, the regulated handoff and the review loop all consume everything upstream and feed the shop's next bath.

dominance_rules.rule: Cyanide-acid segregation dominates every lifecycle routing, staging and storage choice
dominance_rules.rationale: acid contact with any cyanide stream liberates hydrogen cyanide; no economic or schedule argument survives that
dominance_rules.trigger: any decision that moves, stores or routes a lifecycle stream
dominance_rules.action: block any option that lets cyanide and acid streams share a zone, drain, tool or path; keep cyanide streams alkaline and labeled

dominance_rules.rule: Waste compliance beats gold value whenever they collide
dominance_rules.rationale: an uncompliant holding or disposal event costs more than any recoverable gold and cannot be undone
dominance_rules.trigger: in-house recovery extending hazardous holding beyond the shop's storage or license classes
dominance_rules.action: route the stream to the refiner or licensed handler and realize the recovery credit there

dominance_rules.rule: A verified differential verdict beats every treatment reflex
dominance_rules.rationale: treating the wrong class wastes the cycle, strips additives or gold needlessly, and leaves the real killer working
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to dose, carbon-treat, dummy or dump a bath
dominance_rules.action: require the recorded verdict with its converging evidence first; block treatment without it

dominance_rules.rule: Quarantine beats throughput on credible suspicion
dominance_rules.rationale: one held afternoon is a bounded cost; a poisoned batch of customer work is not
dominance_rules.trigger: a suspect bath with customer work scheduled into it
dominance_rules.action: hold the tank, stop drag-out returns, run coupons only, release on a passing verification coupon

dominance_rules.rule: The TDS and supplier guidance beat bench folklore on every number
dominance_rules.rationale: tolerances and treatment doses belong to the specific commercial product, and invented limits masquerade as knowledge
dominance_rules.trigger: any lifecycle document or decision citing a number
dominance_rules.action: trace the number to the TDS, the supplier or a labeled handbook class, or strike it and ask the supplier

dominance_rules.rule: The build bath beats the strike everywhere their interests conflict
dominance_rules.rationale: the strike is the cheap sacrificial fuse; the build bath is the expensive protected asset
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to nurse, dose or stretch a turning strike
dominance_rules.action: dump and remake the strike with gold recovery; never spend build-bath protection to save strike cost

dominance_rules.rule: Repeat-signature evidence beats sunk treatment cost
dominance_rules.rationale: a second verified return of the same signature means the source or the age remains, and further treatment funds a pattern
dominance_rules.trigger: the same verified signature returning after a completed treatment cycle
dominance_rules.action: move the bath to the regenerate-versus-replace decision with the ledger's cost curve on the table

dominance_rules.rule: Recovery precedes destruction on every gold-bearing stream
dominance_rules.rationale: gold destroyed or shipped uncharacterized is value and paperwork lost simultaneously
dominance_rules.trigger: any retirement, dump or disposal of a gold-bearing solution, filter or medium
dominance_rules.action: document the recovery decision first, then characterize and hand off by the sanctioned route

dominance_rules.rule: Prevention taxes stay on under deadline pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: drain-dwell, rinse refreshes, covers and dedicated tools are priced against a killed build bath, not against the minutes they cost
dominance_rules.trigger: a schedule argument for skipping a prevention step
dominance_rules.action: keep the step; answer the argument with the ledger's record of what the last shortcut cost

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the mortality map before authoring any signature chart or treatment playbook
anti_rework_rules.prevents: diagnosis and treatment documents built on unlisted routes, which collapse the first time a real source is off the map

anti_rework_rules.rule: Clear the TDS window by analysis before running the contamination differential
anti_rework_rules.prevents: expensive 'treatment' of ordinary parameter drift that the sibling KB's methods would have caught in minutes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Quarantine and coupon the bath before any dose, pack or dummy run
anti_rework_rules.prevents: destroying the diagnostic signal and plating customer work on a bath mid-experiment

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix or close the identified ingress route before treating the bath
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a clean treatment immediately re-poisoned by the still-open source, doubling the cycle

anti_rework_rules.rule: Condition every treatment's success on an after-coupon before customer work resumes
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a batch of rework discovered on customer pieces instead of on one coupon

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tie the drag-out return rule to a visible bath-status tag before plumbing any return
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recontamination loops when a bath's status changes faster than the bench's habits

anti_rework_rules.rule: Open the age ledger at make-up, not at first illness
anti_rework_rules.prevents: regenerate-versus-replace decisions argued from memory over a biography that was never written

anti_rework_rules.rule: Characterize and label every spent stream on the day it is generated
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unshippable mystery containers, lost refiner credits and staging that violates segregation

anti_rework_rules.rule: File the post-mortem before the successor bath goes live
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding the same death with fresh chemistry and calling it bad luck

iteration_protocol.trigger: a verified signature returns after a completed treatment cycle
iteration_protocol.action: re-open the source audit across drag-in routes and wet hardware, escalate to the supplier lab, and move the bath to the economics decision

iteration_protocol.trigger: coupon, Hull cell or supplier lab evidence contradicts a signature chart's reading
iteration_protocol.action: correct the chart against the confirmed result and record the overturned case as a chart-calibration entry

iteration_protocol.trigger: the jurisdiction's waste, discharge or hazmat rules change
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the segregation staging rules and the retirement runbook's exit routes before the next stream is generated

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new product or revised TDS arrives on the line
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the affected lifecycle sheet - sanctioned treatments, media, water class, re-additive package - and review the signature charts it touches

iteration_protocol.trigger: the ledger shows estimated drag-out loss exceeding captured recovery
iteration_protocol.action: redesign withdrawal, dwell and capture, and re-check the rinse recovery hardware against the season's numbers

iteration_protocol.trigger: gold price movement or changed refiner terms shift the recovery economics
iteration_protocol.action: recompute the in-house-versus-refiner balance and the regenerate-versus-replace thresholds that depend on the recovery credit

iteration_protocol.trigger: a bath death post-mortem is completed
iteration_protocol.action: fold its findings into the mortality map, the signature charts, the inspection cadences and the prevention checklists
